sources.testInventoryJson: docs/program/evidence/F0-005_test_inventory.json (baselineCommit 7fcf2f850f151241266f07349c4bf4442c72bbca, 2026-07-19 - stale relative to designBaselineCommit, see openQuestions)

evidenceStalenessNote: TEST_OWNERSHIP.md/F0-005 counted 72 backend + 6 frontend test files at commit 7fcf2f850f1. server/src/tests/ now has 96 files and frontend has 9 files (including 2 new *.vitest.test.tsx component tests) at designBaselineCommit, a 7-day/24-file drift. This design's domain-to-test mapping is therefore evidence-accurate at the domain/ownership level (module boundaries do not churn as fast as file counts) but NOT a complete enumeration of every current test file. Any future CI implementation of this design MUST regenerate F0-005-equivalent test inventory evidence against its own execution baseline before going live - see RISK_REGISTER.md R-072.

LOW.definition: No high-risk dimension touched; blast radius confined to one non-shared file; no data mutation path; no auth/tenant/consent/audit/financial/storage/queue/imaging/integration/public-contract code reachable from the diff per DEPENDENCY_MAP.md.
measurableProperties: no DATA_WRITE edge in F0-004 originates from a changed file

MEDIUM.definition: Confined to a single non-core domain's routes/services/frontend with at most a DATA_READ or same-domain DATA_WRITE edge; no shared/high-fan-in module touched.
measurableProperties: changed file's DEPENDENCY_MAP.md fanIn/fanOut both below the domain-median threshold (see confidenceModel.fanOutThresholds)
no high-risk dimension flag set except possibly one of {webhook, queue} at LOW severity

HIGH.definition: Touches a domain with fanOut >= 60 in DEPENDENCY_MAP.md (WHA=106, PRV=97, RPT=67, PAD=64), OR touches any one high-risk dimension (webhook, AI, imaging, financial, cross-domain, public-contract), OR touches a domain-owned raw-SQL location without crossing into tenant/auth/schema.
measurableProperties: exactly one CRITICAL-tier high-risk dimension flag set
OR a documented ADR-015 X-violation edge is inside the diff

CRITICAL.definition: Touches tenant isolation, authentication/session/CSRF, KVKK/privacy/consent, audit integrity, migrations/schema, raw SQL with tenant-scope implications, storage/attachment authorization, or any shared utility with fanIn >= 100 (IDA=114, ORG=128, APT=116).
measurableProperties: two or more high-risk dimension flags set
OR the changed file is one of the 34 server/src/utils/*.ts cross-cutting primitives
OR the changed file/domain has DEPENDENCY_MAP.md fanIn >= 100
OR the change is CT-08/CT-09/CT-10/CT-11/CT-19/CT-22/CT-23 by taxonomy

testScopeLevels.name: documentation-validation-only
testScopeLevels.description: Markdown lint / link-check / JSON-parse validation of changed docs. No application test executes.

testScopeLevels.name: narrow-unit-static
testScopeLevels.description: Typecheck (tsc --noEmit) plus the single owning test file(s) for the changed path, per TEST_OWNERSHIP.md canonicalOwner/sourceFilesProtected mapping.

testScopeLevels.name: module-level-suite
testScopeLevels.description: All test files whose canonicalOwner or secondaryDomains match the changed file's owning domain (per F0-003/F0-005), run together.

testScopeLevels.name: cross-module-integration-suite
testScopeLevels.description: The owning domain's full suite plus every domain listed as a DEPENDENCY_MAP.md direct dependent (one hop) of the owning domain, plus any test file whose secondaryDomains[] names the owning domain.

testScopeLevels.name: full-backend-frontend-suite
testScopeLevels.description: The entire server `npm run test` chain and the entire frontend test chain (`npm run test:vitest` plus any legacy frontend runner). Used when the change touches a CRITICAL-risk dimension, a high fan-in/fan-out module, or public/shared contract surface.

testScopeLevels.name: disposable-database-migration-verification
testScopeLevels.description: S4 plus a disposable-Postgres migration-forward rehearsal (prisma migrate deploy against a fresh disposable database) and, where the change is additive, a rollback-safety check per the F0-011-P2 rehearsal pattern. No production database is touched.

testScopeLevels.name: production-safe-verification-package
testScopeLevels.description: A synthetic-fixture, read-mostly production verification package equivalent in spirit to the KVKK-HIGH-006/R-061 production-safe smoke packages already used in this program. NOT automatically executed by CI at any point in this design - requires a separate, explicit, per-change human authorization, exactly like every existing production verification in this program's history.

confidenceModel.HIGH: Changed file has an exact, unambiguous canonicalOwner entry in TEST_OWNERSHIP.md/F0-005, appears in exactly one DEPENDENCY_MAP.md domain, and that domain's fanOut is fully enumerated in F0-004.
confidenceModel.MEDIUM: Changed file's domain is known but the file itself is new (post-evidence-baseline) and its ownership must be inferred from directory convention (e.g. server/src/services/whatsapp/newFile.ts inferred as WHA) rather than an explicit F0-003/F0-005 record.
confidenceModel.LOW: Changed file sits in a directory shared by multiple domains (e.g. server/src/utils/**), or its dependency edges are not fully enumerated in F0-004 (evidence gap, not absence of risk).
confidenceModel.UNKNOWN: Changed file has no discoverable owning domain (new top-level directory, generated code, dynamic require/import, or a path outside every root this design's evidence covers), OR the dependency/test-ownership evidence itself is stale beyond a defined staleness threshold (see openQuestions).
confidenceModel.escalationRule: MEDIUM widens the selected test scope by one S-level from its taxonomy default. LOW and UNKNOWN both force S4 regardless of taxonomy default, unless the change is already S5/S6 by taxonomy, in which case the higher level applies.
confidenceModel.stalenessThreshold: If the F0-005-equivalent test/dependency evidence backing a future CI implementation is more than 30 days or 50 merged PRs old (whichever first), confidence for every classification derived from it must be treated as LOW, not HIGH, until refreshed.

openQuestions: Whether a future CI implementation computes moduleDomainInventory fanIn/fanOut live (via a dependency-graph tool) or continues to snapshot it from F0-004-style evidence on a fixed refresh cadence - not decided by this design (see main design document open questions).

Whether AIO (Messaging AI Orchestration) should be split into its own risk-tracked domain with a dedicated RISK_REGISTER.md row, given it currently inherits WHA's risk tier only by association - flagged, not resolved, by this design.
